services.title: Everything your piano will ever need
services.subtitle: One trusted, independent partner — from choosing an instrument to caring for it for decades.
services.s1Desc: One-to-one advice, in your home or by video, to find the right instrument — with no brand agenda.
services.s2Desc: We locate the right piano, new or used, and negotiate a fair, informed price on your behalf.
services.s3Desc: Independent written valuations for purchase, insurance, inheritance or sale.
services.s4Desc: Access to a vetted network of accredited tuners and technicians across Iberia.
services.s5Desc: We specify and oversee restoration so quality and long-term value are protected.
services.s6Desc: Specialist moving, insurance guidance and help selling or trading up fairly.

journey.title: The journey to the right piano
journey.subtitle: A calm, guided path — we're beside you at every step, and long after.
journey.step1Desc: A relaxed conversation about your playing, space, taste and budget. No pressure, no jargon.
journey.step2Desc: A curated shortlist across brands, new and used, with the trade-offs explained clearly.
journey.step3Desc: We arrange playing sessions so you compare instruments like for like.
journey.step4Desc: For pre-owned and used, an independent technician verifies condition before you commit.
journey.step5Desc: We negotiate a fair price and arrange specialist delivery and installation.
journey.step6Desc: Ongoing tuning, regulation and advice for as long as you own the piano.
